title: Big arms and thighs: can you slim down just those areas?
intro: The honest answer: you can't choose to lose fat from only your arms or thighs. But you can lower your overall body fat and build muscle, so your arms and thighs look more toned over time.

sections.p: When you work out your arms, your arm muscles do the work. But the fat that gets burned comes from your whole body, not just that spot. Your body decides which fat goes first, not the exercise you choose.

sections.h: Why fat likes to sit on the thighs and arms
sections.p: Many women naturally store more fat on the thighs, hips and upper arms. This is influenced by hormones and genetics, and it's normal. These areas are often among the last to go down, so you need patience.
Eat in a small calorie deficit, not a crash diet. A realistic target is an estimated 0.5 to 1 kg a week. Add full-body strength training 2 to 3 times a week and more daily steps.

sections.h: Exercises that help shape your body
sections.p: For the lower body, try squats, lunges and glute bridges. For the upper body, try wall push-ups and rows using a water bottle or a bag filled with books. Stronger muscles make your arms and thighs look firmer as the fat comes off.

If your weight goes up suddenly, your periods are irregular or you feel very tired for no reason, see a doctor first. Conditions like PCOS or thyroid problems can affect your weight. A doctor can do the right check-ups.

action: Do 3 strength training sessions of 20 minutes this week: squats, lunges, wall push-ups and rows.
Include one protein source every time you eat, for example eggs, chicken, fish or tofu.
Aim for 7,000 to 8,000 steps a day, including walking to the surau or pantry.
Measure your arms and thighs today, then measure again after 4 weeks.
myth: Many believe doing 100 tricep dips every day will melt arm fat. In reality, it strengthens your arm muscles, but fat only goes down when your overall body fat goes down.

faq.q: How long before I see a difference in my arms and thighs?
faq.a: Everyone is different. Many start to notice changes in their clothes and measurements after 6 to 12 weeks of being consistent. Thighs often take longer, so don't give up too early.

faq.q: If I lift weights, will my arms get bulky?
faq.a: It's very hard for women to get bulky by accident. With normal training 2 to 3 times a week, your muscles get firmer and your shape looks more toned, not bulky.

faq.q: I have PCOS. Can I follow this approach?
faq.a: The principles of balanced eating and strength training usually suit many people. But please discuss with your doctor first, especially if you're taking medication or have other symptoms.
